description: Box S3 (Google TV 14), «pair with code» dialog open: the answer to a PTR query for _adb-tls-pairing._tcp. The pairing service uses its own host name (Android_<uuid>.local), not the connect service's Android.local. Captured 2026-10-27; serial, session suffix, host uuid, IPv4 and IPv6 replaced byte-for-byte with neutral values of the same length.
